input: Hi, where is my order #48213? I ordered last Tuesday and it still says processing.
expected: Hi there, thanks for checking in. Order #48213 is still processing, which means it hasn't left our warehouse yet. Most orders dispatch within 2 business days, so this one is running a little behind, and I'm sorry about that. I've flagged it with the warehouse team so it goes out with today's shipments. As soon as it's dispatched you'll get an email with your tracking link, and standard delivery takes 3–6 business days from then.

input: My package says delivered but its NOT here. checked with neighbours, nothing. order 51190
expected: Hi there, I'm sorry, that's really frustrating. For order #51190, could you check two quick things: whether it was left in a less obvious spot (behind planters, in a mailroom or with building reception), and whether the delivery photo in your tracking email shows your door? If it still hasn't turned up by the end of tomorrow, reply here and I'll open a missing-parcel claim with the courier and arrange a replacement or refund for you.

input: I want to return the linen duvet cover, it's too warm. Bought it 2 weeks ago. Order 47002
expected: Hi there, no problem, you're well within the 30-day return window. As long as the duvet cover is unused with its tags attached, you can return it. Go to Orders in your account, choose order #47002 and select Return item, and we'll email you a prepaid label. Because this isn't a defect, $6.95 return shipping will be deducted from your refund. Once our warehouse scans the return, your refund reaches your original payment method within 5–10 business days.

input: Can I change my delivery address? I just placed order #52310 and put my old apartment by mistake
expected: Hi there, good catch. Order #52310 is still processing, so we can change the address. Please reply with the full new address, including apartment number and postcode, and I'll update it before the order is dispatched.

input: the code SPRING15 isnt working at checkout?? it says not valid
expected: Hi there, sorry about that. A few things can stop a code from applying: it can only be used once per order, it doesn't work on gift cards or final-sale items, and it can't be combined with another code. If your basket has final-sale items or another code is already applied, try removing those and adding SPRING15 again. If it still says not valid, reply with a screenshot of your basket and I'll take a look.

input: What size should I get in the Harbor crew sweater? I'm usually a M in most brands but between sizes
expected: Hi there, the Harbor crew sweater has a relaxed fit, so most customers who are between sizes go with their usual size, M in your case. If you prefer a closer fit, size down. You can also check the measurements in the size guide on the product page. And if it doesn't fit, you get one free size exchange.

input: This is the THIRD time I'm writing. My refund for order 44871 still hasn't arrived and it's been over 3 weeks. I want to talk to a real person.
expected: Hi there, I'm sorry you've had to write three times. That's not the experience we want for you. I've passed order #44871 to our support team with a note that your refund is overdue and that you've asked to speak to a person. A team member will reply within 1 business day with the refund status and a reference you can give to your bank.

input: hi i got the wrong item. ordered the sage green throw blanket and got a grey one. order 50021
expected: Hi there, I'm sorry, we sent you the wrong colour. Since the mistake was ours, the return is free. I'll email you a prepaid return label for the grey blanket, and we'll ship the sage green one as soon as it's scanned at our warehouse. If you'd rather have a refund than a replacement, just let me know.

input: Do you ship to Canada? And how long does it take?
expected: Hi there, yes, we ship to Canada. International standard delivery usually takes 7–12 business days, and you'll see the exact shipping cost at checkout before you pay. Import duties or taxes may be charged by Canadian customs when the parcel arrives.

input: The ceramic lamp I ordered arrived smashed. Box was crushed. Order #49900. It was $240.
expected: Hi there, I'm so sorry your lamp arrived broken. Could you reply with a few photos of the lamp and the box, including the shipping label? Because of the order value, I'm passing this to our support team with your photos. They'll reply within 1 business day to arrange a replacement or a full refund, and you won't need to send the broken lamp back unless they ask.

input: I forgot my password and the reset email never comes
expected: Hi there, sorry about that. Reset emails can take a few minutes and sometimes land in spam or promotions folders, so please check those first. Also make sure you're using the email address you signed up with. If nothing arrives within 15 minutes, reply with that email address and I'll check the account and send a new reset link.

input: Can I cancel my order? Just realised I don't need it. #52477
expected: Hi there, order #52477 is still processing, so I can cancel it for you. I've requested the cancellation and you'll get a confirmation email shortly. The refund goes back to your original payment method, and depending on your bank it can take 3–5 business days to show up.

input: i ordered 2 things, one came, the other didnt. is it coming separately? order 51544 also can i use my gift card on the next order
expected: Hi there, thanks for your message. Yes, items in order #51544 can ship separately when they come from different warehouses, and each parcel gets its own tracking email. Check your inbox for a second dispatch email. If you can't find one, reply and I'll check the status of the missing item. And yes, you can use your gift card on your next order: just enter the code at checkout. Gift cards never expire.

input: Your website charged me twice for the same order!!
expected: Hi there, I'm sorry for the worry. Often the second charge is a temporary authorisation hold that your bank releases within 3–5 business days. Could you reply with your order number and the date and amount of both charges? I'll check whether two orders were created and fix it if so. If you see charges for an order you don't recognise, let me know and I'll pass it to our team straight away.

input: Is the oak serving board food safe? And how do I clean it
expected: Hi there, yes, the oak serving board is finished with a food-safe mineral oil. To clean it, hand wash with warm soapy water, dry it straight away and don't soak it or put it in the dishwasher. Rubbing in a little food-grade mineral oil every few weeks keeps the wood from drying out.

input: I want to exchange my jeans for a size up. how does that work
expected: Hi there, happy to help. You get one free size exchange per item. Go to Orders in your account, select the jeans and choose Exchange, then pick the new size. We'll email you a free return label, and we'll ship the new size as soon as your original pair is scanned at our warehouse. The jeans need to be unworn with tags attached.

input: Hello, I bought a dress on sale marked final sale and it doesn't fit. Can I return it please? Order 46610
expected: Hi there, I'm sorry the dress didn't fit. Items marked final sale at checkout can't be returned or exchanged, and unfortunately that includes this dress in order #46610. If it arrived damaged or faulty, though, reply with a photo and I'll be glad to help.

input: When will the blue Harbor sweater be back in stock in L?
expected: Hi there, I don't have a restock date for the blue Harbor sweater in L right now. The quickest way to know is the Notify me button on the product page: we'll email you as soon as it's back. Sorry I can't give you a firmer date.

input: Order 38822 hasnt moved in tracking for 2 weeks. stuck at 'in transit'. What is going on
expected: Hi there, I'm sorry, two weeks without a tracking update is too long. I've passed order #38822 to our support team to open an investigation with the courier. They'll reply within 1 business day with an update, and if the parcel can't be found they'll arrange a replacement or a full refund.

input: Can I add an item to my order? I just placed it 5 min ago. #52501
expected: Hi there, unfortunately we can't add items to an order once it's placed. The easiest option is to place a second order for the extra item. If you'd prefer one delivery, I can cancel #52501 while it's still processing so you can reorder everything together. Just let me know.

input: I never ordered this. Someone used my card on your site. order 52099
expected: Hi there, I'm sorry, that's alarming. I've passed order #52099 to our support team as a suspected unauthorised order and asked them to stop it from shipping if it hasn't left yet. They'll reply within 1 business day. Please also contact your bank or card issuer to report the charge and protect your card.

input: hi! do you do gift wrapping? its for my moms birthday on saturday
expected: Hi there, how lovely! Yes, you can add gift wrapping and a personal note at checkout for any item. To make sure it arrives by Saturday, choose express delivery, which takes 1–2 business days domestically, and order soon. The exact estimated delivery date is shown at checkout.

input: the return label you sent doesn't work, post office said barcode invalid
expected: Hi there, sorry about the trouble at the post office. Please reply with your order number and I'll generate a fresh return label for you. If you've already paid to send the parcel yourself, keep the receipt and send it to us so we can sort out the cost.

input: Absolutely ridiculous. Ordered a rug 10 days ago, paid for EXPRESS, still not here. I want my shipping fee back NOW.
expected: Hi there, I'm sorry, you paid for express delivery and didn't get it, so your frustration is completely fair. Could you reply with your order number? I'll check where the rug is right away and refund the express shipping fee, since we didn't deliver on time.

input: Do you have a physical store I can visit?
expected: Hi there, we're online only, so there's no physical store to visit. You can browse the full range on our website, and returns and exchanges are free for size swaps, so trying things at home is easy.

input: My refund was less than what I paid?? Returned a sweater worth $68 and got $61.05
expected: Hi there, I understand the confusion. The $6.95 difference is the return shipping charge, which is deducted when an item is returned for reasons other than a defect or our mistake. $68.00 minus $6.95 is $61.05. If the sweater was faulty or we sent the wrong item, reply with your order number and I'll look at refunding the shipping charge.

input: Hi, I'd like to know if you offer student discounts, and also my order 50877 shows delivered to the wrong city?!
expected: Hi there, thanks for your message. We don't offer a student discount at the moment, but subscribers to our newsletter get 10% off their first order. As for order #50877, a delivery to the wrong city needs looking into straight away. Could you confirm the full address you expected it to go to? I'll compare it with the order and open a claim with the courier if it was misdelivered.

input: can u send me a new gift card code? i lost the email
expected: Hi there, sure. Please reply with the email address the gift card was sent to (or the purchaser's email if it was a gift to you) and roughly when it was bought. I'll find it and resend the code to that email address.
